About Abir Bakes

Abir Bakes is a small artisan bakery crafting personalized cakes, sweet treats and savory bites. We focus on custom creations for birthdays, events and intimate gatherings. Everything is baked fresh with attention to detail and a love for flavor.

How to Order

  1. Choisir le type de création (cake, cupcakes, dessert box, savory bites).
  2. Envoyer une demande via Instagram en précisant date, taille, goûts et référence.
  3. Confirmer le design, la date et le prix avec Abir.
